description: Returns metadata for a Chat conversation including type, muted status, group details, and your unread state. For the unread state, request chat_conversation.fields=unread,last_read_event_id,newest_event_id: those fields give your read state, computed from your latest read receipt and the conversation's latest notifying message. Use chat_conversation.fields to select which fields are returned. Use expansions to hydrate member, admin, or participant user objects. Use user.fields to control which profile fields are returned for expanded users; in a 1:1 chat, user.fields=receives_your_chat on the participant says how you can message them: encrypted, unencrypted, or none.

chat_conversation.fields.description: A comma separated list of ChatConversation fields to display.

expansions.description: A comma separated list of fields to expand.

user.fields.description: A comma separated list of User fields to display.
